english.title: Registrar refuse / omit to register a birth / death / particulars
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a registrar,

(A)_[refused]_
(B)_[without reasonable cause omitted]_

to register

(C)_[a birth]_
(D)_[a death]_
(E)_[particulars concerning which information had been tendered to you by a qualified informant, namely **(..SPECIFY PARTICULARS..)]_

which you were required to register by or under the Births and Deaths Registration Act 1953
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(a) of the Births and Deaths Registration Act 1953.
